EmailTemplate.name: EEA KYC Refresh - Wave 3 & 4.EDU - English - Email 1
EmailTemplate.subject: Action Required - KYC Refresh
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Valued Client}},
We wish to provide you with an important update regarding our services.
Due to the UK’s decision to withdraw from the European Union, Flywire is required to make some changes to the way it provides services to its clients in the European Economic Area (EEA).
Specifically, we are assigning our customers based in the EEA over to Flywire’s newly regulated entity in Lithuania. This will be the primary entity that we will use to contract for the provision of services to our customers in Europe going forward.
In order to complete this transition and ensure uninterrupted service to you, we are required to perform a ‘Know Your Customer’ (KYC) refresh. This will ensure all information is kept up to date as we transition your institution from our UK entity to Lithuania.
What do you need to do? In the next few days, we will send you an additional email asking you to provide specific documentation pertaining to your institution, similar to the documentation you provided initially when your contract was signed. This email will come directly from our secure document collection tool, FileInvite (response@docs.flywire.com), and will have the subject “Flywire KYC Refresh”.
To learn more about the KYC refresh process and how Flywire is managing this transition, click on the following link to access Frequently Asked Questions <[[https://help.client.flywire.com/hc/en-us/articles/360015862700]]>. If you have any other questions about this process, simply reply to this email, and we’ll be happy to answer.
Sincerely,
The Flywire Team Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States Copyright ©Flywire. 2011-2020 All rights reserved. Flywire is a trademark of Flywire Corporation.
